name: RAGPPI
description: RAGPPI is a factual question-answer benchmark focused on identifying the biological impacts of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) to support target identification in drug discovery. It contains 4,420 QA pairs, including a gold-standard set annotated by experts and a larger silver-standard set generated via an ensemble auto-evaluation LLM reflecting expert labeling.
reputation: A recent specialized biomedical QA benchmark that is still emerging and has limited community adoption compared with established science QA datasets.
notes: Includes expert-driven gold-standard data and a larger silver-standard dataset generated by an ensemble LLM; designed to support RAG systems in drug discovery QA.
